notes.title: Live Gameplay – Academy: Become a Hero
notes.notes:
[p]Join me for a live gameplay session of [i]Academy: Become a Hero[/i]!
I’ll be diving into intense time-based challenges, exploring the Hero Academy, and showcasing the game’s special abilities in action.
You’ll get a closer look at the unique level design and what it takes to become a true Hero — through danger, precision, and style.[/p][p]I’ll also be available to answer your questions live — see you there![/p]
